note: Models whose skinned meshes the runtime mesh cut (MeshCut) needs readable. glTFast 6.20 has NO mesh Read/Write importer key (only texturesReadable); its meshes are created with new Mesh() + UploadMeshData(false), so they are readable already. FinisherReadable verifies mesh.isReadable per file and sets an importer key only if one of importerKeys exists (future glTFast).
